summary: EBR Systems filed an 8-K regarding a fully underwritten A$150M capital raise on the ASX, consisting of an institutional placement (A$64.4M) and a 1-for-2 pro rata accelerated non-renounceable entitlement offer (A$85.6M). The offer price per CDI was A$0.38, a 19.1% discount to last closing price. Tranche 1 and the institutional entitlement offer settled June 11; Tranche 2 requires shareholder approval. The retail entitlement opens June 11. This is a discounted equity issuance to raise capital, not a return of capital. Watch for shareholder vote and retail uptake.
